Name: Fish and Aquarium reskin for -Better Fishing and Beach Foraging-
Author: Danekokun
Description:
[center]This is my first mod that I made just for my game, but I wanted to share it in case someone else was interested.
For now, I have only changed the textures of the aquarium for the fish that cometkins had already made for their mod,
but I plan to finish it completely. I want to make the missing fish and their animations for the tank.

[size=4][b][u]UPDATE:
[/u][/b][/size]I've added 16 of the[b] missing fishes.[/b] There's still some missing that I plan to finish in the future

It is necessary to have the mod[url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6915] "(WIP) Better Fishing and Beach Foraging"[/url]﻿
Since it will be needed to see the textures when fishing 

[b]I used his mod as a base and also some assets, so credits to cometkins!
Thanks for some new assets as well![/b][/center]
